howto.what: 它把 Discord 适配器拷进 src/channels/ 并注册、安装 @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0,再构建跑注册测试;然后引导你创建 bot、存凭证、重启服务并解析私聊频道。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 频道时触发;它作为 /setup 流程的一步,或通过 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 接入。

say.text: 帮我的 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 频道
say.note: 会拷贝适配器并引导创建 bot

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token:xxxx
say.note: 校验 token 并推导应用凭证

say.text: Discord 注册测试没过,帮我排查

howto.what_en: It copies the Discord adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0, builds, and runs the registration test. Then it guides bot setup, credentials, restart, and DM channel resolution.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Discord channel to NanoClaw. It runs as a step in /setup, or via /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel to my NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, then guides bot creation.

say_en.text: Here's my Discord Bot Token: xxxx
say_en.note: Validates the token and derives the app credentials.

say_en.text: The Discord registration test is failing — help me debug it.
say_en.note: Re-runs the test to check the import and package.
